title: Commanders DT Johnny Newton still feels "confidence boost" from end of 2025 season

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Commanders DT Johnny Newton still feels "confidence boost" from end of 2025 season
sources.description: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said in April that he believes defensive tackle Johnny Newton is "about to absolutely take off" in his third season with the team and the close to his 2025 campaign has something to do with that.
